basis.scope: Static reachability and consumer classification only. This record does not authorize W2, code movement, schema, migration, catalog, deployment, runtime, or appservice mutation.

import_groups.falsifying_test: A new or missing local edge is absent from the AST scan, or future storage imports application, CLI, Vuoro, runner, or execution policy.
Claim, lease, managed dispatch, group, or runner-proof imports remain reachable from federation roots after their staged removal.
Runner gains an import edge to the root actionq package, or W6 closes without a reviewed retire/extract/transfer decision and zero federation reach.
The execution/v1 contract export changes before the runner decision and coordinated catalog cutover.

console_script_groups.falsifying_test: A root console script disappears, changes target, or silently maps a legacy write name to federation semantics.
The runner script survives W6 without a reviewed retire/extract/transfer decision or becomes reachable from federation roots.

cli_command_groups.falsifying_test: A supported federation CLI exposes queue, claim, renewal, terminal execution, cancellation, sweep, group-control, or arbitrary coordinator-event writes.
Archive reads mutate execution rows, expose fenced secrets, or are removed before zero-consumer and retention proof.
Migration/compatibility cannot check execution and federation independently, or publication remains claim-authorized rather than evidence-authorized.

catalog_operation_groups.falsifying_test: Any queue/claim/lease/settlement/cancellation/group/managed-dispatch/session execution write crosses federation/v1 or aliases to a new name.
Execution/v1 read operation bytes/hashes drift before explicit catalog removal or an archive read writes either domain.
Evidence/completion observations are lost, retain claim/runner authority, or enter federation/v1 without stale-catalog rejection and exact global revision.

migration_groups.falsifying_test: A migration byte, name, version, order, checksum, domain, API version, or maximum changes, or execution migration 013 appears.

workspace_package_groups.falsifying_test: W6 closes without a reviewed disposition, the runner becomes reachable from federation roots, or files/scripts change without reclassification.
The execution/v1 contract package changes before runner disposition and coordinated catalog compatibility proof.

api_consumers.purpose: Pin every tracked source, packaging, script, test, verification, and maintained-document path that consumes a current ActionQ API or execution catalog anchor.

retired_plane.purpose: Make every surviving deleted-plane name explicit so a new stale normative/runtime anchor fails closed. Historical evidence is excluded from this maintained-surface scan.

repository_consumer_groups.falsifying_test: A maintained consumer/callable disappears without a facade, or retained evidence/CAS/completion/schema behavior is not represented in the new federation boundary.
A supported federation root or catalog retains queue, claim, lease, terminal execution, group, managed-dispatch, runner-proof, or dispatcher-gate authority.
Historical facts or immutable execution assets are rewritten/deleted, or an archived document is treated as current federation authority.
Runner packaging/tests/docs change or W6 closes before a reviewed retire/extract/transfer outcome and zero federation reach proof.

retired_plane_anchor_groups.falsifying_test: A new production/generated anchor invokes or names the deleted daemon/server/session-wrapper plane as current authority.
Historical rollout hazards or deletion gates are presented as live execution instructions, or their evidence is rewritten.
A blocked-name safety check becomes a launcher, or runner/hybrid guidance survives W6 without the reviewed runner disposition.

critical_reachability.falsifying_test: Any listed worker/claim/lease/queue/group/settlement authority crosses federation roots or disappears from the compatibility inventory before W5 fencing.
The successor requires an action row/claim receipt, treats CAS as authorization, prunes v1 changes, or loses deterministic projection.
Runner proof or cancellation acknowledgement grants federation mutation or the historical fence is omitted from archive/backfill coverage.
Evidence bytes are accepted without digest verification, publication remains claim-coupled, or historical candidate/publication facts are lost.
Replay accepts gaps/duplicates/digest conflicts, rebuild differs from live projection, or completion observation is treated as proof ActionQ executed work.
Migration assets/order/checksums drift, execution 013 exists, package data omits frozen assets, or an unclassified console script appears.

operations: immutable execution/v1 history and archive schema
critical_reachability.falsifying_test: Any execution migration is reclassified as federation successor schema, omitted, mutated, or extended by 013.

external_consumers.falsifying_test: W4 lacks literal full ActionQ/Vuoro SHAs and fetched wheel digests, execution/v1 bytes drift, federation/v1 is not a separate fifth domain, or stale catalog reaches ActionQ.
The tombstone resolves or starts actionq-daemon, reads queue/config, returns success, or is described as a compatibility launcher.
A stale q-spec is used as tranche-4 implementation authority or supersession omits the dispatcher tombstone and native-runtime/federation boundary.
Archive-session reads are removed before takeup sweep has a native lifecycle source and migration tests.

operations: historical daemon plans with supersession markers
external_consumers.falsifying_test: Generated current guidance instructs starting the retired daemon/dispatcher or a historical plan lacks an explicit native-runtime/federation supersession boundary.
PR16 merges/deploys before ordered appservice proof and interactive service disable, or a refresh script reinstalls a daemon/runner entry point.
Phase 2 precedes phase 1 health proof, namespace pruning deletes vscode/CNPG/cockpit, or any non-operator session mutates/reconciles the cluster.

semantic_asset_inheritance.falsifying_test: A selected semantic root is added, removed, or changes category without an explicit W1 disposition.

effective_disposition_rule: atomic symbol/import/constant entries override their python-surface or import-group inventory default; critical_reachability is an index only and must reconcile every symbol to that single effective disposition; successor semantics must use distinct names and may not override frozen legacy symbols.

python_surfaces.falsifying_test: A new root callable or class appears without an explicit W1 disposition.
The resource owner remains action-row/claim coupled, loses a callable during later facade work, or a symbol changes without updating this manifest.
The facade changes or disappears before retained federation and frozen archive callers have separately proven adapters.
A federation root imports or exposes claim or lease-renewal authority.
Claim-coupled terminal/cancellation behavior crosses the federation seam or evidence/publication behavior is lost while splitting the mixed service.
Federation policy inherits runner proof, managed dispatch, claim settlement, or an unpinned callable disappears.
Dispatch/enqueue authority is reachable from federation application roots.
Queue enqueue is reinterpreted as federation create, or immutable evidence/candidate behavior is lost during separation.
Execution-group launch or stop authority appears in federation application/catalog roots.
Legacy coordinator/session writes survive as federation authority or required archive reads disappear without a replacement.
Content-address verification changes, or the renamed seam grants execution authority instead of proving evidence bytes.
A legacy command silently aliases federation semantics, or a callable disappears before versioned deprecation and cutover.
Completion identity/digest conflict, cursor ordering, recovery floor, or quarantine behavior is lost in the federation repository.
Response-loss recovery, digest verification, retry, acknowledgement, or capsule rebuild evidence is lost or treated as native execution authority.
Later splitting loses a current facade callable, preserves claim/lease in storage, or leaves db/schema circular through the new storage seam.
Harness/model/prompt routing or managed enqueue crosses the federation seam.
Runner proof becomes permission to create or mutate a federation resource.
Execution migration bytes/order/checksums drift, execution 013 appears, or schema mechanics keep importing the monolithic db after seam extraction.
The 26-operation execution/v1 catalog drifts before coordinated cutover or a new federation catalog inherits legacy execution authority.
